title: SM ST9C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST9C static excitation system with automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Time constant of differential part of AVR, T_CD (s)}, {RegFilter time constant of differential part of AVR, T_BD (s)}, {Dead-band for differential part influence on AVR, Z_A (1)}, {AVR gain, K_A (1)}, {Gain associated with activation of takeover UEL, K_U (1)}, {Time constant of AVR, T_A (s)}, {Time constant of underexcitation limiter, T_AUEL (s)}, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Power converter gain (proportional to supply voltage), K_AS (pu)}, {Equivalent time constant of power converter firing control, T_AS (s)} sets the time constant of power converter firing, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} sets the potential circuit voltage gain coefficient, {Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with the compound source, X_L (pu)} sets the compound source reactance, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Maximum limit on exciter voltage based on supply condition, V_Bmax (pu)} sets the exciter voltage upper limit and {Switch to select exciter supply configuration} sets the power source selector Position A: power source derived from generator terminal. Values come from the instance.
